children: MONTREAL, Sept. 3, 2026 /CNW/ -- Transat A.T. Inc. ("Transat"), a leisure travel reference worldwide, particularly as an air carrier under the Air Transat brand, will release its third-quarter 2026 results –ended July 31– on September 10. Annick Guérard, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Jean-François Pruneau, Chief Financial Officer, invite financial analysts to take part in a conference call the same day. Media are welcome to attend the conference call in a listen-only mode.
To join the conference call without operator assistance, you may register and enter your phone number
to receive an instant automated call back.
You can also dial direct to be entered into the call by an operator:
The conference will also be accessible live via webcast:

An audio replay will be available until September 17, 2026, by dialling 1 888 660-6345 (toll-free in North America), access code 78793 followed by the pound key (#). The webcast will remain available for 90 days following the call.

Founded in Montreal in 1987, Transat has achieved worldwide recognition as a provider of leisure travel particularly as an airline under the Air Transat brand. Voted World's Best Leisure Airline by passengers at the 2025 Skytrax World Airline Awards, it flies to international destinations. Air Transat's fleet includes some of the most energy-efficient aircraft in their category. Based in Montreal, Transat has over 5,000 employees with a common purpose to bring people closer together. (
